LoginForm.title: Log in

Appearance.title: Appearance
Appearance.intro: Choose a theme for the overall look. Oshi colors add accents on top. Also set text size, density, language, and dates.
Appearance.themeHint: Background, text, and overall mood change together. Default is green. Frame contrast shows light vs dark.
Appearance.oshiHint: Colors layered on the theme. Expand to try them in the sample.
Appearance.readabilityHint: Pick text size and UI density (line spacing and list padding) in steps.
Appearance.languageHint: Reflected in the URL (Japanese has no prefix; English uses /en).
Appearance.residenceHint: Region used for dates like registration day. Separate from UI language. Default is Japan.

OshiAccent.addonLabel: Optional layer on top of the theme
OshiAccent.previewingAppWide: App-wide preview on (theme button colors are temporarily hidden)
OshiAccent.livePreviewHint: When off, only the sample changes so theme picks stay visible on the page.
OshiAccent.hint: Up to two colors (like hair and eyes). Text color is chosen automatically. Check colors in the sample box.
OshiAccent.contrastError: This pair cannot meet contrast. Pick different colors.
OshiAccent.lockExplain: Applying and saving across the app is a Premium feature. You can still pick colors and preview them in the sample.

Residence.regionHint: Search and pick a country or region for default local time, date, and money style.
Residence.currencyNoFxHint: Only the symbol and grouping change (no FX conversion).
Residence.productCurrencyHint: Currency used when you bought this item (used in list and detail).
Residence.currencyHint: Usually follows residence. Override to change the symbol only.
Residence.currencyFormatHint: How digits and symbols are written. Stored numbers stay the same.
Residence.tzHint: Usually follows residence. Override with any IANA time zone worldwide.
Residence.formatHint: How numbers are written. Separate from time zone.

DisplaySettings.uiDensityHint: Line spacing and padding change together
DisplaySettings.galleryCardFieldsHint: What to show on each card. Photo-only is fine too.
DisplaySettings.previewBody: Product names and notes appear at this size and spacing. Moving the bar updates instantly.

SettingsIndex.title: Settings
SettingsIndex.intro: Appearance, register flow, tags, storage, data, and account
SettingsIndex.appearanceHint: Theme, oshi colors, text size, density, language, residence
SettingsIndex.designLab: Design Lab (compare layouts · dev · no login)

DataExport.title: Export your data
DataExport.intro: Keep a copy of your list on your device. Re-import into the app is not supported.
DataExport.textHint: Best for inventory-style lists. Products, tags, and storage as text (ZIP). Photo files are not included.
DataExport.mediaHint: Best when you want visuals too. Includes list data plus photo files. Preparing may take a while.
DataExport.noteNoImport: There is no way to load this file back into the app (download-only backup).
DataExport.errorBusy: A photo export is already in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
DataExport.errorFailed: Export failed. Please try again later.
DataExport.errorTimeout: Preparing took too long. If you have many items, try the list-only export.
DataExport.errorGeneric: Export failed. Check your connection and try again.

photo.hint: Best when many items have no barcode

RegisterDefaults.frequencyHint: With no default, frequently chosen storage appears first (not auto-selected).

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.overviewBody: oshi-app (the "Service") is a web app for registering and organizing merch for your oshi. This page explains what information we handle and why.
Privacy.collectItemAccount: Account information (such as email; authentication via Supabase Auth)
Privacy.collectItemGoods: Registered merch data, tags, storage locations, and notes
Privacy.collectItemLogs: Technical logs needed to improve the service (full auth tokens are not included)
Privacy.purposeBody: We use collected information only to provide the Service (register, list, search, settings) and for security and incident response.
Privacy.photosBody: We do not retain uploaded photos externally for third-party model retraining or dataset building. Assist features (such as image description) depend on your actions; external assist success is never required to save your data.
Privacy.isolationBody: Each user's data is isolated by signed-in user (JWT members_id) and is not visible to other users (Row Level Security).
Privacy.contactBody: For questions about this policy, contact the app operator. (Contact details will be added when we publish more broadly.)
